facts: Parties: Kingsmere Industries Ltd (Buyer), Lowther Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Kestrel Energy plc.
This Agreement is dated 27 April 2027; Closing is scheduled for 8 July 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $200,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Northgate Pharma plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Oakhurst Media Ltd.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,380,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $38,760,000.
